Name: Dusty to Poochyena 1.6
Author: cookiesncrime
Description:
Instructions:

Download PNGs
Unzip PNGs

Dusty Overhaul\[CC] Dusty Overhaul\Companions\DustyRoam
- replace the three images

Dusty Overhaul\[CP] Dusty Overhaul\assets\Characters
- replace one image

Dusty Overhaul\[CP] Dusty Overhaul\assets\Portraits
- replace one image

Done! Enjoy your new friendly neighborhood Pokemon.



Credits: Artists of "Pokemon Mystery Dungeon", shared online at https://sprites.pmdcollab.org/#/0261?form=0 

If you're having problems, make sure the file names remain the same when you replace the image!

Downloads.Description: All Poochyena image files needed for in-town Dusty

Download and replace two files in Dusty Overhaul to rename Dusty to Poochy

If you'd like to change Poochy's name:
Use Control+F to find all instances of Poochy in both files and replace with the name of your choice
